## Summary
What changed, why, and which Issue does this address?

## Scope
Affected files/behavior. Call out schema, permissions, account, and shared-file changes.

## Verification actually executed
- Commands/environment:
- Results:
- Not executed / limitations:
- Sanitized desktop/mobile and FR/AR screenshots for UI changes:

## Checklist
- [ ] Target is main; changes are on a separate task branch.
- [ ] Scope is limited to this PHP project and the assigned task.
- [ ] PHP/JS syntax and relevant integration tests passed (or failures explained).
- [ ] Tests used a disposable _test database, never real/staging data.
- [ ] Backend authorization/CSRF and Editor restrictions remain intact.
- [ ] French/Arabic, RTL, keyboard, and mobile behavior checked when relevant.
- [ ] Source and compiled CSS committed together if CSS changed.
- [ ] No credentials, .env, passwords/hashes, private uploads, dumps, sessions, logs, or node_modules included.
- [ ] Team Lead review requested; no merge without approval.
